name: Feng Jia-The Everlasting lovestory at the Windcap
original_name: 风岬-The Everlasting lovestory at the Windcap
source:
Abandoned by the world, I Forgotten by the time, she Lonely souls drawn to each other Unhappy lives clinging together

A fairy tale of happiness we wove But it turned into a curse of woe Homeless Yuyan, saved by a firework That lit up the winter sky like a goldfish

Yuwu, who adopted her, feared to love The name of love was too much to bear Ten years of living day and night The love overflowed and broke the moral plight

Can the fish finally get her wish And jump into the ocean of love?
translation:
被世界抛弃的我 被时间遗忘的她 孤独的灵魂相互吸引 不幸的生活紧紧相拥

我们编织的幸福童话 却变成了悲伤的诅咒 无家可归的玉言，被烟花救了 像金鱼一样照亮了冬日的天空

收养她的玉舞却害怕爱爱之名难以承受十年朝夕生活爱泛滥打破道德困境

鱼儿最终能否如愿，跳进爱情的海洋呢？
